items.title: American International Group Inc's Dividend Analysis
items.summary: American International Group Inc (NYSE:AIG) recently announced a total dividend of $0.50 per share, with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-09-16. As investors look forward to this upcoming payment, the spotlight also shines on the company's dividend history, yield, and growth rates.
